system.description: When you use a Force Power that affects targets within an area (such as a radius or a cone), you can spend a Force Point to double the distance that the effect extends from your square (for example, a 6-square cone can be made into a 12-square cone). Alternatively, you can spend a Destiny Point to multiply the distance the effect extends by 5 (making a 6-square cone into a 30-square cone).

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Force Unleashed Campaign Guide
